title: A Ghost for the Drop
author: Ansel Brightwater
blurb: Felix Almeida, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
